title: ‘Like caring for a pet’: the app that lets you know if your neighbourhood tree is thirsty
summary: Gieß den Kiez app shows trees in critical need of watering and can be adopted by other heat-stressed cities around the world Amanda Gläser-Bligh sometimes attracts puzzled looks when she goes to water the eight-year-old street tree she has adopted outside her door in Charlottenburg, Berlin. “I named her Linda the linden,” she says. “Berliners are not always known for being super friendly but most people react really positively when they find out what I’m doing.” Continue reading...
author: Emma Snaith
